variants.name: Super Armor Piercing
variants.info:
For 5.45x39mm firearms.
Changes your ammunition to red tipped super armor piercing rounds.
Damage drops off immediately with vastly increased bullet penetration (+40%) but harshly cuts at long range damage (-10%) and reduces head damage multiplier (-7.5%).

variants.name: 60rd Magazine
variants.info:
Loads your RPK-16 with a 60rd magazine, eliminating a lot of reload time and weight!
Larger ammo reserve pool, slightly increased handling and mobility speeds but also slightly increased recoil from the reduced weight.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
